purpose: Separate evidence freshness from empirically calibrated decision confidence.
rules: Raw model confidence is not accepted as calibrated confidence.
Deterministic policy outputs must be labeled DETERMINISTIC_POLICY rather than model confidence.
Calibration must be measured per decision_type and model/version where sample size supports it.
If calibration evidence is insufficient, confidence basis remains UNCALIBRATED_MODEL.
Low or unproven confidence may return REVIEW, UNKNOWN or ESCALATE rather than forced binary output.
